get_history.name: Get sleep and environmental history
get_history.description: Returns a catalogue of up to 60 cloud reports, or up to two reports with environmental charts. Use report_id to select one report. Dates label report periods; sleep estimates may be unavailable. Noise and light have no calibrated physical unit. Device export is requested only when sync is enabled.

limit.name: Reports
limit.description: Number of recent reports to return: 1–60 for metadata only, at most 2 with charts unless a report_id selects one report.

report_id.name: Report identifier
report_id.description: Optional report_id from the catalogue for this REMI. Selects that single report instead of the most recent reports.

include_series.name: Include charts
include_series.description: Download chart files for the selected reports. Turn off to browse up to 60 reports without downloading chart files.

refresh.name: Refresh cloud data
refresh.description: Read cloud metadata again and clear cached chart files. Does not send a command to REMI.

sync.name: Request an export from REMI
sync.description: Explicitly ask REMI to publish its logs, wait 12 seconds, then refresh cloud data. This can take at least 12 seconds and does not guarantee recovery of missing days.

remi_id.name: REMI identifier
remi_id.description: Optional when exactly one REMI integration is loaded.
